text:
Ellen: Urgent — Beacon POC import is getting 429s across /v1/embeddings.batch. Importer ran overnight and now demo is blocked. Any quick ideas?

Ravi: Can you share tenant id, batch/concurrency and any server response bodies?

Ellen: Tenant beacon-poc-5. They were running 5 workers with batch_size=600. Attached single response snippet from their logs: 

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
{"error":"rate_limit","code":"token_budget_exhausted","retry_after_ms":180000,"route":"/v1/embeddings.batch","tenant_id":"beacon-poc-5","tokens":210000}
```

Hiro: Code token_budget_exhausted is decisive — tenant balance hit. Two immediate options: (A) temporary token top-up for the tenant, (B) per-route override to raise tokens_per_min. Top-up is scoped to balance and safer for other routes.

Marta: Customer insists they had enough trial credit. CRM shows trial balance at 150k tokens earlier today. Can we top-up 250k for 2 hours to finish import? I'll mark it as demo accommodation.

billing-bot: [automated] Top-up API: POST /internal/billing/topup {"tenant_id":"<id>","tokens":<n>,"expires_minutes":<m>} — AE approval required for >200k tokens.

Ravi: Quick mitigation: ask them to pause heavy workers and run a validation with 1 worker batch=128 to confirm behavior while we decide. If that clears, it's definitely budget-related.

Ellen: They paused and ran the small test at 06:12Z — no 429s for 4 minutes. They can hold for 20 minutes but prefer a fast solution to finish import before demo.

Hiro: Given AE approval, top-up is the cleanest. Marta, can you approve 250k tokens for 120 minutes? I'll apply and post the id.

Marta: Approved. Logging in CRM: Beacon demo accommodation, 250k tokens, 120m expiry.

billing-bot: [automated] Top-up applied: topup-20260501-44 for tenant beacon-poc-5 +250000 tokens, expires in 120 minutes.

Hiro: Top-up applied at 06:18Z. Please resume import in 5 minutes and keep to max concurrency=3 while we monitor.

Ellen: Resumed at 06:24Z. Customer reports import progressing; they reduced concurrency to 3 per request.

Ravi: For post-demo follow-up: recommend permanent quota conversation if they need sustained high throughput, and add a POC checklist item to verify current token balance before large imports. Also provide client guidance: batching=<=256 and exponential backoff with jitter.

Marta: Noted. I'll schedule a technical handoff to review quota needs and add the top-up as a one-time concession in the deal notes.

Hiro: Monitoring now. No 429s observed in the 30m window after resume. Top-up expires at 08:18Z; I'll report before expiry.

Ellen: Demo succeeded at 07:10Z. Customer grateful for quick response.

billing-bot: [automated] Top-up topup-20260501-44 scheduled expiry at 08:18Z.

Hiro: Top-up expired at 08:18Z; no further 429 alerts. Closing thread and adding runbook note: "If token_budget_exhausted -> prefer top-up + reduce concurrency; reserve per-route override for route-specific bursts."

Ellen: Thanks all 4aa. Closing.
